text: Added FrameSpec and GridSpec structural metadata snapshots while retaining nominal FrameId/GridId and Agreement as the sole comparison seam. Agreement now returns ordinary mismatch for distinct identities, success for equal identity plus equal specification, and operand-rich FrameIdentityConflict/GridIdentityConflict for one identity attached to incompatible bounds, axis, frame membership, or dimensions. N-ary agreement uses the same seam. Bounds.clamp now targets nextDown of each half-open upper bound, so contains(clamp(p)) holds for all tested finite side cases. Focused AgreementSuite plus GeometrySuite pass 27/27 on JVM and 27/27 on Scala.js; compileAll and checkBoundaries pass. The trust court improved identically from 12 failures/6 controls to 9 failures/9 passes on JVM and JS: exactly frame conflict, grid conflict, and clamp closure turned green.
